categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Tongxing Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of refrigeration-related products, including heat exchangers, refrigeration system pipe assemblies, automotive air conditioning pipelines, and refrigeration unit modules. The company serves sectors such as light commercial refrigeration equipment, household refrigeration, heat pump dryers, new energy vehicles, data centers, and cold chain logistics. It also provides entrusted processing services for refrigeration system pipe assemblies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies such as finned heat exchangers connected by expansion tube technology for efficient heat exchange. It employs flexible production methods characterized by multi-variety, small-batch production with rapid mold switching. The company emphasizes R&D-driven innovation, including proprietary equipment with multiple invention patents, unique cleaning formulas, and processes ensuring product cleanliness and reliability. It also integrates digital and intelligent technologies in product development, such as smart variable frequency cooling fans and high-efficiency microchannel heat exchangers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading refrigeration equipment manufacturers and automotive companies such as Haier Group, Hisense Group, Midea Group, LG Electronics, Xingxing Cold Chain, Changan Automobile Group, Chery Automobile, Carrier, and Invek. The products serve markets in light commercial refrigeration, household refrigeration, new energy vehicles, data centers, cold chain logistics, and industrial refrigeration. The company has a strong presence in the domestic Chinese market and is expanding internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in domestic markets accounting for over 90% of revenue. It also has growing overseas sales, representing about 8% of total revenue. The company is actively expanding its global footprint by establishing overseas production bases and subsidiaries in Singapore and Thailand, aiming to accelerate globalization.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Tongxing Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the refrigeration and automotive air conditioning supply chain, focusing on the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of core components such as heat exchangers and pipe assemblies. It supplies these components to downstream original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in refrigeration and automotive sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes green, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly refrigeration technologies, focusing on low-carbon, high-efficiency finned heat exchanger manufacturing. R&D efforts target product upgrades, new product development, and integration of intelligent and IoT technologies. Key projects include smart variable frequency cooling fans, integrated aluminum condenser modules, high-performance evaporators, thermal management modules for new energy vehicles, and digital temperature regulation heat exchangers for data centers. The company collaborates with universities and research institutes and leverages national and provincial innovation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of refrigeration components and modules to OEM customers under contract or order-based procurement. The company also earns income from entrusted processing services for refrigeration system pipe assemblies. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with contracts often including framework agreements and specific purchase orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in finned heat exchangers within the light commercial refrigeration sector in China, recognized for product and technological advantages. It competes with other domestic and international refrigeration component manufacturers and automotive parts suppliers. Its strong customer base and technological innovation provide competitive differentiation and market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.13 billion, representing a 15.66% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 126.8 million, up 6.19%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability over recent years, supported by expanding orders in refrigeration components and automotive air conditioning parts, especially driven by the new energy vehicle market. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.7 billion with stable equity growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Tongxing Technology emphasizes precise product positioning, focusing on light commercial refrigeration and new energy vehicle air conditioning components with high customization and flexible production. It offers innovative, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly products with superior quality control, supported by proprietary technologies and patented equipment. The company provides integrated pre-sales, in-process, and post-sales services to ensure timely delivery, quality assurance, and continuous innovation, fostering strong customer loyalty and competitive advantage.
